project_type: Laravel Botble CMS multivendor ecommerce marketplace with Martfury theme
language: PHP 8.1+, Laravel 10.x, Blade templates, vanilla JavaScript
build_system: Composer for PHP dependencies, Laravel Mix/Vite for asset compilation
test_framework: Not configured in workspace - manual testing required
build_command: composer install && php artisan migrate (if migrations added)
test_command: Manual testing: visit homepage, insert shortcode in admin, verify AJAX endpoint returns JSON, check product display
verification_instructions: 1. Register shortcode in shortcodes.php. 2. Insert shortcode via admin panel on a page. 3. Visit page and verify products display. 4. Test Load More button/auto-load. 5. Verify only published products from approved stores appear. 6. Check browser console for errors. 7. Test responsive layout on mobile.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None - assets are compiled via Laravel Mix but not checked into version control for this change
environment_constraints: Cart facade (Gloudemans\Shoppingcart) is NOT available on frontend routes - it's admin-only in this setup. Wishlist tracking uses ec_wish_lists table. Compare is tracked via Cart::instance('compare') but no persistent table exists. Product views tracked in ec_products.views column. Order completion tracked via ec_order_product join to ec_orders table filtering OrderStatusEnum::COMPLETED.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing Botble plugin/theme patterns. Services go under platform/plugins/ecommerce/src/Services/Products/. Routes registered in platform/plugins/ecommerce/routes/base.php following existing AJAX patterns. Shortcodes registered in platform/themes/martfury/functions/shortcodes.php. Blade partials under platform/themes/martfury/partials/short-codes/. JavaScript under platform/themes/martfury/assets/js/. Match existing code style: 4-space indentation, PSR-12, camelCase for JS, snake_case for DB columns.
key_patterns: 1. Shortcodes: register with add_shortcode(), admin config via ShortcodeForm, render via Theme::partial(). 2. AJAX routes: GET /ajax/<feature-name> in base.php, controller method in PublicProductController or dedicated controller. 3. Product queries: use ProductInterface repository with 'condition', 'take', 'with' => EcommerceHelper::withProductEagerLoadingRelations(), 'select'. 4. Multivendor safety: always join or filter by store approval status, product status = PUBLISHED, is_variation = 0. 5. Blade partials: use product-card-enhanced.blade.php with layout='flyout'. 6. JS: attach event listeners to .js-load-more-smart-products, use fetch() for AJAX, append HTML, handle errors with console + UI feedback.
directory_structure: platform/plugins/ecommerce/src/Services/Products/ - product-related service classes | platform/themes/martfury/functions/ - theme functions including shortcodes.php | platform/themes/martfury/partials/short-codes/ - shortcode Blade views | platform/themes/martfury/assets/js/ - frontend JavaScript | platform/plugins/ecommerce/routes/ - route definitions | platform/plugins/ecommerce/src/Http/Controllers/Fronts/ - frontend controllers
